Hi Bernie,

Thank you, and that photo is exactly what we needed. Please don't send anything else, and don't worry about the missing RMA number on the box, that's our fault for emailing you after you'd already posted it.

The label you used goes to our returns warehouse in Chattanooga, so the unit is on the right path. A colleague is picking this up today to open the return there under the reference ···· and attach the label, so the warehouse can match your parcel to your file when it lands rather than treating it as an unknown box.

One thing would help a lot: if you still have the USPS drop-off receipt, reply with the tracking number on it. That lets us watch the package in and check it in the moment it arrives.

Your replacement is already set aside: a Hammer Miner DC06 (330 MH/s), free of charge, in stock at our US warehouse and held under order Shop····. It ships as soon as your L1 is checked in, and the tracking comes to you by email.

Sorry again for how long this has taken.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thanks for your patience through all of this, and sorry you had to chase it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
